Online tax returns

Online tax returns, prepared and lodged by a registered agent

Individuals, sole traders, companies, partnerships, trusts and self-managed super funds. You send the information online, a registered tax agent prepares and reviews the return, and nothing is lodged until you approve it. Every fee is fixed and quoted before we start.

  • Individual tax return

    Employees, sole traders, investors and anyone with a rental property or capital gain. Deductions checked against your occupation, and the agent lodgement deadline instead of 31 October.

    Individual returns

  • Company tax return

    Financial statements, the company return, franking account and Division 7A loan checks for your Pty Ltd, all in one engagement.

    Company returns

  • Partnership tax return

    The partnership return and each partner’s share of the net income, calculated to your agreement and flowed through to their own returns.

    Partnership returns

  • Trust tax return

    Trust accounts, the distribution resolution before 30 June, the trust return, and beneficiaries’ shares reported correctly.

    Trust returns

  • SMSF annual return

    Fund accounts, member statements, the independent audit arranged for you, and the SMSF annual return lodged with the supervisory levy.

    SMSF returns

  • Superannuation refund

    Claiming your super back after leaving Australia on a temporary visa, and tracking down lost or unclaimed super held by the ATO.

    Super refunds

How an online return works with us

You start online and tell us what kind of return you need. We pull the data the ATO already holds, including income statements, bank interest, dividends and private health cover, so you’re not typing in what the government already knows. A registered agent works through what’s left with you: deductions, business income, rental schedules, capital gains, and the parts pre-fill gets wrong.

You see the finished return and the result before anything is lodged. Because we lodge as your agent, most individuals get until the following May rather than 31 October, provided you’re on our client list before 31 October and your earlier returns are up to date. Our fee can be taken out of your refund for $44, and it’s deductible next year.

Every return is prepared by BRS Advisory Pty Ltd, registered tax agent 26233684 and a CPA Australia Public Practice. You can check our registration on the Tax Practitioners Board register. Every client is identity-verified before we lodge — a three-minute electronic check, included in the fee, no exceptions.

Setting up first?

If the entity doesn’t exist yet, or you need registrations before your first return, start here.

Company setup Trust setup Partnership setup SMSF setup ABN application GST registration Bookkeeping

Ready to lodge it?

A registered agent prepares it, checks it, and lodges it.

Most refunds land within two weeks of assessment. The fee is fixed and quoted before we start — nothing is charged until you approve the finished return.
